description: How the seven-card relationship tarot spread works for partners, family, friends or colleagues, with each position explained and tips for balanced reading.
lede: The relationship tarot spread uses seven cards to look at two people and the connection between them. It suits any kind of relationship, not just romantic ones.

layout.alt: Seven numbered tarot cards for a relationship spread: 1 You on the left, 2 The other person on the right, 3 Connection in the centre between them, 4 Brings you together above the centre, 5 Challenge below the centre, and a lower row with 6 Could help on the left and 7 Where it may head on the right.
layout.caption: Each person has a card, with the connection between them in the centre and what draws them together and tests them above and below.
